claims.statement: This checkpoint prepares a reader study on the twelve existing development filings, with no natural QA execution.
limits: No held-out/generalization or algorithmic novelty claim.

claims.statement: The original table extraction retained a storage-cap failure; the separately frozen gzip amendment completes all twelve sources without changing extraction logic.
claims.evidence_level: Preserved technical failure and storage-only amendment
limits: Original partial outputs are not reclassified as successful.
DOM extraction is not browser rendering or semantic evidence verification.

claims.statement: The complete structural views contain 23,651 numeric occurrences, 1,765 tables and 16,861 rows; the independent streaming storage audit passes after its own retained field-location mistake is corrected.
claims.evidence_level: Aggregate inventory and container provenance audit
limits: Shared extractor/v15 lineage; not independent parser conformance.

claims.statement: The original fixed revenue-table selection fills 13 of 24 planned table slots; four physical filings have no selected table. That outcome remains unchanged.
limits: Original execution is preserved separately from the later post-inspection visibility amendment.
Complete execution does not mean complete source coverage or admitted questions.

claims.statement: The selector applies the revenue/net-sales predicate independently within each row after a pre-freeze review found an across-row false match.
limits: Review of rule implementation does not establish semantic completeness.

claims.statement: The binding interface uses acquired-only immutable packs with explicit aspect witnesses and no hidden full-source lookup.
limits: Same-process malicious introspection is outside the API boundary.
Producer must independently remove every duplicate disclosure of withheld relations.

claims.statement: Independent interface review preserves an initial 28-test run with 6 failures and 1 error; the corrected implementation passes 71 combined authored tests.
claims.evidence_level: Authored tests and preserved engineering defects
limits: Tests do not validate question meaning, natural QA accuracy or model superiority.

claims.statement: Exact supported scoped values and citations remain separate from semantic question correctness; direct-reader wrong values are preserved for grading.
limits: An incorrect question-to-handle mapping can remain schema-valid and must fail external reference grading.

claims.statement: The separately frozen visibility-only amendment fills 21 of 24 table slots and covers all twelve sources, with 29 newly eligible tables, seven original selections retained and six displaced by earlier eligible tables.
limits: All nonvisibility predicates replay unchanged.
The rule permits only conservatively empty layout subtrees; it is not computed CSS visibility.
Table coverage does not establish admitted questions or complete evidence.

claims.statement: The acquired native candidate stops at the original prelaunch memory guard: zero model processes, zero tokenized prompts and zero completion calls out of eight planned authored calls.
limits: No model-performance measurement was obtained.
No native retry or transfer to the small-process resource amendment occurred.

claims.statement: The authored Story rendering fails merged-column geometry despite passing its code tests. LibreOffice retains the tested year/value geometry but does not retain the declared borders and width.
limits: Qualified office inspection aid only; no browser fidelity.
Authored success does not admit any natural question or reference.

claims.statement: Dependency capture records 117 resources including one transport timeout; eleven source closures are complete. The original twelve-source validation attempt is refused before worker launch.
claims.evidence_level: Captured metadata and preserved resource failure
limits: Candidate metadata does not establish original SEC byte identity.
No completed comparison follows from dependency acquisition.

claims.statement: The v16.2 small-process resource amendment produces twelve processor failures and no completed inventory or comparison. The later diagnosis finds mixed physical/logical DOM traversal and unreliable process RSS lookup.
limits: No claim of 2 GiB RSS enforcement for this attempt.
The pressure-proxy policy differs from the old total-current soft cap.
No processor-failure result is reclassified by a later repair.

format_disclosure: ReportLab working PDF plus generic editable TeX; ACL template/TeX compilation not verified.
pause_note: User requested stop/save. This is a preparation draft, not a completed experiment or final paper. No new PDF generation or test run was performed at pause.
